name: The Liar's Table
description: A seeded dinner-party theft: five suspects, a hidden ground-truth timeline, and four evidence files (door log, a staff witness, bar receipts, CCTV with gaps). Exactly one suspect is the thief and lies about where they were during the theft; everyone else tells the truth, and on hard seeds one honest guest misremembers (and hedges) an irrelevant detail. The model interrogates with enumerated questions under a 12-question budget and must find the contradiction. It separates models that cross-check testimony systematically from those that guess, over-ask, or chase red herrings.
hook: Five suspects. One liar. Twelve questions. Who cracks the case fastest?
author: Gauntlet Core
